global_design_tokens.description: Colors and typography are mapped to CSS :root variables for instant builder theming.

editable_content_rules.text: All editable text elements are marked with [data-editable='text'] and a unique [data-id].
editable_content_rules.images: Images are marked with [data-editable='image']. Images are safely wrapped in aspect-ratio containers (.media-container-16-9, .media-container-4-3) with object-fit: cover to prevent user uploads from breaking the layout.
editable_content_rules.icons: Icons are marked with [data-editable='icon'] and expect FontAwesome class strings.
